item.title: Tsuki wa Higashi ni Hi wa Nishi ni ~Operation Sanctuary~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: AUGUST, Fupac Co., Ltd.
  • 発売日: 2003-09-26
  • スコア: 6.63/10 (64 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 月は東に日は西に ～Operation Sanctuary～
  • 英語名: Tsuki wa Higashi ni Hi wa Nishi ni Operation Sanctuary

别名

  • hani hani

あらすじ

The girl that fell out of the blue.

And the protagonist’s life, which began to take a turn little by little into the realm of the extraordinary starting from that very day.

「Nao-kun, if you don’t get up soon, you’re going to be late.」
